Note: This space moves insanely fast, so here are two quick updates:
- GPT-4.5 was already discontinued and is no longer available. 
- I also believed the early hype, but ChatGPT-5’s context window is actually 400k tokens, not the rumored 1 million.

In this episode I rank the eight core ChatGPT products, models, and features from worst to best and show how to make money with each one. I break down what they do, when to use them, and real examples from simple wrappers with GPT-4.1 to deploying GPT OSS locally for enterprise clients. We cover Sora for AI video, deep research for McKinsey-level analysis, and ChatGPT Agent for full task automation. Just hours after filming, ChatGPT-5 launched, combining the best of all these tools into one powerful model with a million-token context window, elite coding and writing, and far fewer hallucinations.


Enjoy!
